artikel.titel: FX Daily: US inflation to offer some support to USD today
artikel.text: The dollar has handed back most of last week’s gains on the back of a rebound in risk sentiment, also helped by further declines in energy prices. But we expect a slightly hotter-than-expected 0.3% MoM US core CPI print today to offer the dollar some support. We see some stabilisation in EUR/USD for the remainder of this week

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: US inflation likely too hot for comfort
artikel.text: The direct pass-through from oil to rates has weakened compared with a few months ago, as markets turn their attention to inflation data. We expect the US core CPI reading to come in at 0.3% MoM, which is too hot to support lower rates. The ongoing AI jitters do help a 10yr UST yield of 5% look relatively attractive, supporting inflows into longer rates

artikel.titel: Chinese trade continues to ride the global AI boom
artikel.text: ASIA/PACIFIC: Chinese exports had another strong month in October, and year-to-date exports have already eclipsed last year's total. Import growth accelerated as crude oil import values rose on top of continued tech strength. China remains well on pace for a new record high for the trade surplus by year-end despite a miss in October

artikel.titel: US Dollar Credit Supply: October slowdown
artikel.text: October supply drops, but Reverse Yankees continue to impress
Euro corporate issuance slowed sharply in October, but YTD supply remains historically strong at €426bn

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Dollar rally needs more risk-off fuel
artikel.text: Contagion from AI to defensive stocks in the US and worldwide allowed the dollar to rally even before the strong US jobs market report. But unless risk sentiment remains poor this week, lower front-end US rates should favour a weaker dollar, even if inflation tomorrow comes in slightly hotter than expected

artikel.titel: China’s inflation cooled in October amid falling food prices
artikel.text: ASIA/PACIFIC: China’s inflation moderated as food costs matched a 13-month low, driven by a sharp decline in vegetable prices. Core inflation dipped to a 9-month low of 0.8%. China has emerged from deflation this year, helped by firmer energy and technology prices, but inflation remains well below target

artikel.titel: Robust US jobs market boosts December rate hike chances
artikel.text: NORTH AMERICA: The Federal Reserve has been focusing more on inflation recently, but a strong jobs report for October makes a December rate hike an even easier decision

artikel.titel: More signs of life in Hungary’s economy
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Both industry and retail sales expanded in September. Positive surprises appeared in both sets of data. As Hungary’s growth is expected to be supported by internal factors, the external influence remains the only question mark in the recovery story

artikel.titel: CEE & CCA week ahead: Polish GDP and regional inflation data
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Poland will release third-quarter GDP, final inflation and current account data next week, while Hungary publishes September inflation figures

trendfolge.regel: Absolute Momentum, 3 Monate (63 Handelstage), täglich entschieden (Antonacci 2014: 12 Monate, monatlich)
trendfolge.hinweis: Täglich entschieden und 3 statt 12 Monate Rückschau sind eigene Wahl, das Paper entscheidet monatlich über 12 Monate. Beides bringt mehr Fehlsignale, wenn der Markt schnell dreht. Keine Anlageberatung.
